mm7/hnrdr.name: hnrdr
mm7/hnrdr.material: one complete picture made of two pieces that continue seamlessly into each other: a golden-ochre rough stucco plaster wall under one straight carved golden-brown wooden cornice of horizontal moulding bands that runs across the whole width at one constant height and thickness, with a carved golden-brown wooden skirting moulding along the bottom; in the centre a wide arched double door of riveted dark wooden planks, each leaf with a barred window, an iron ring handle and a carved skull near the bottom; two carved horned demon head shields hang just below the cornice above the door; copy the composition exactly
